name: Decisions
description:
Decisions is the secure meeting management platform for Microsoft 365 and Teams — trusted by thousands of organizations to turn meetings into results.

Your calendar knows when meetings happen. Decisions knows what they're for and what came out of them: structured agendas, AI Recap summaries, AI Minutes, a formal decision log, and action items synced to Microsoft Planner. Connect the two, and Claude gets smarter about your meetings and decisions — every answer grounded in a proper system of record.

What you can do:
• Prepare in minutes — "What's on the agenda for tomorrow's leadership team meeting?" Claude pulls the agenda, presenters, and files, then helps draft your talking points.
• Know what was decided — "What did we agree in Friday's steering meeting?" Answers come from your team's logged decision register, not memory. Or review the log itself: "List the decisions we've made this quarter."
• Keep momentum — AI Recap summaries, takeaways, and open action items with owners, due dates, and status.
• Find the files — decks, notes, and recordings tied to any meeting across SharePoint, OneDrive, and Teams.
• Shape the agenda — add or update items as an organizer, or suggest items for the organizer to approve.

Ask in your own words — search understands natural phrasing; no exact meeting titles needed.

Enterprise-grade by design: Decisions is built natively on Microsoft 365, so meeting content never leaves your organization's tenant — agendas in OneDrive and SharePoint, decisions in SharePoint lists, tasks in Planner. Claude connects with each user's own signed-in identity, and existing Microsoft 365 permissions always apply. Security documentation: https://trust.meetingdecisions.com

Getting started: a Decisions account on your Microsoft 365 tenant — free to start. If Decisions is new to your organization, your Microsoft 365 admin can grant tenant-wide consent at https://app.boarddecisions.com/web/#/admin-consent

Decisions — turning meetings into results.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Decisions to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Decisions to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.meetingculture.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Decisions MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Decisions provides these MCP tools: add_agenda_item, get_decisions_and_tasks, get_meeting_details, get_meeting_files, publish_agenda, search_meetings, suggest_agenda_item, and update_agenda_item.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Decisions?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Decisions in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.
Decisions requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Decisions is developed by Decisions. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
